data: Really good music and cute visuals, and it's free
Looking forward to what VC brings in future updates, I would definitely recommend
It's so cute, the music is amazing, and I love the small customization for your character/pet

better than sex ngl

good for relaxing or studying, nice choice of extra effects and epic taste in music. Definitely Reccomendable
It's not a game. You don't do anything. Its more like an experience. You can listen to different noises to help you focus or relax. Bit like ASMR.

Virtual Cottage is a cozy productivity app that invites players into a tranquil digital retreat designed to help you focus and unwind. Set in a charming little cottage, the experience revolves around setting a timer, choosing lo-fi music, and tackling tasks in a calming environment. The game doesn’t push goals or challenges—instead, it gently encourages mindfulness and intentionality, making it perfect for quiet reflection or deep work.

I highly recommend trying Virtual Cottage if you enjoy ambient experiences that blend relaxation with productivity. It offers a unique space to disconnect from distractions and reconnect with your intentions, making it a must-try for fans of cozy games and focus tools alike.

it's a cute way to motivate yourself to work. I love the persoanalized ambient. And I think it would be wonderful to have the ability personalize the character and the room, and to connect Spotify or other music streaming apps to control the music
i fear it doesnt actually help in terms of stopping procrastination but i like the different sounds you can play - birdsong is my favourite

i can say that this is a very relaxing game, and it does not take much performance to run. it you life relaxing, or enjoying LO-FI while you do something, this is perfect for you. also theres a feature to edit some sounds.
As someone who has ADHD and has to work in front of the computer all day this is like an upgrade from using notepad for "stuff to do" and other kinds of reminders.
With Virtual Cottage I actually manage to do my homework for once!!!!11!!1! recommended for people with ADD or some thing like that

More than a game to play, this is just a cool screensavers with built-in tools such as a checklist, lo-fi hip-hop playlist, cute dog and cat animations and a weather sound simulator.

Love using it while studying to help me concentrate and to prevent me from using the free screen on the pc to go on netflix or stuff like that.

It's still being updated and I love it.
What I think it is still missing:"
- possibility to link a personal playlist (spotify, soundcloud...) or to listen to podcast without closing it
- general volume control
- graphical customization maybe?

Still, love it and I've been using it a lot recently
Totally recommended

Its cute and nice. I wouldn't really call it a game but its nice having background music on to do things. I'm a tad disappointed the achievements don't show up in the games list on my profile or on my showcase as I got all the achievements.

I started using this mid-Pandemic, and I have not found another tool quite like virtual cottage that keeps my focused and working like this! I LOVE the addition of a Dog option, The music is super nice, I would like to see more available achievements to keep me motivated and maybe an option for a boy sitting in the chair? Everyone I have shown it to has said it has improved their study habits. Will continue using it into University!

This game (can I call you game, Mista?) is doing a lot of things right
- You can fully immerse into a stress and distraction free zone
- The TODO List can only hold 3 entries. The mentality here is step-by-step. You can add more later
- It keeps you reminded what you are doing right now (for all goldfish-brains out there)
- It keeps you reminded on how long you want to spend your time for this task (for all perfectionists out there)

Right time management tool for a lost soul in an overwhelming world
im an achievement hunter and i started idling this while doing college work and it actually helped. thank you DU&I
I wish this would add something like "diary", where you can see how much you have studied or something like that.

This has been the best thing for keeping me focused but also remembering to take breaks!! a lot of the time ill end up making myself work for hours on end only to get nothing done because i keep getting distracted. this helps a lot with that!!

Simple but effective! I struggle to get things done in a timely manner, and I liked having this on in the background while I wrote some quick Steam reviews. I'll be trying it out with schoolwork next! Also echoing a lot of reviews already: I would love to be able to customize my cottage or music!

Para ficar bem claro, não é um game, é um app pra quem gosta de ter algo no fundo enquanto trabalha, estuda para algo. Tu abre o app e configura sons de chuva, lareira, neve e ventos com musica Lo-Fi de fundo.

Recomendo demais, sempre que preciso fazer algo coloco de fundo e cai como uma luva.

this game helped me so much!!! it really allows me to focus on what i need to get done, have a specific to-do list, and feel (overall) really productive!!! the music is really nice and the visuals are soft and easy on the eyes too :D

Really nice for background music when working or gaming/relaxing. achievements are real easy, its also got a lot of nice songs and aditional sound effects: Fireplace, wind, snow, rain, You can even adjust the volume of each sound. Comes with a to-do list which is pretty helpful, a pause or play button if you don't want a certain sound effect in the background or just no music at all. Real nice its free can run on almost anything probably potato pc or laptop. And its free hard to pass on this.

Side note: Needs more songs but other than that real good!
very relaxing and overall fun its a great timer, can also be used just to play relaxing music while you sleep or do other things
its a good but listening to same playlist everytime you study will get boring eventually, you can purchase DLC though, but i wished it had more songs in the base game.
This Virtual Cottage, sound simulator is brilliant. I love using it when I need to study or write Essays for my Uni. :)! I really recommend it.
Since I like having things open in the backround while working, I've tried a lot of different apps.. But this one has been my favourite so far

A great way to keep yourself to task if you are doing work or studying with the timer function, as well as the task to do function.

The music is good, hope they add more! And the weather control sounds are nice (hope they add more!).

10/10 would put money into this program!

I have a huge problem with procrastinating and Virtual Cottage definitely helps me to overcome that. I like how you can customize the atmosphere and background sounds. It's simple enough to not be distracting but has enough little gatgets and options to be really useful. The full screen mode and timer help me to not get distracted by anything. In conclusion: This is a really cozy space for studying and generally being productive. I definitely recommend it!

it's very nice and calm and helps me focus on my work and studies, you should definitely get this game if you like to stay organized with the tasks you have to do, while listening to music or ambient sounds (or if you just like having something running in the background while you work)

This is a great game to get you off the computer but you still want the ambiance of chill study vibes. It helps me to actually stay off my computer and not game by allowing me to have this cabin. Highly recommend if you're in uni and want something to help with the study goals.
Really enjoy the lofi music and the general atmosphere. Would be cool to customize the cottage.

I mostly have Virtual Cottage open for music in the background while I do schoolwork, but I also love the encouraging achievement descriptions popping up in the corner every now and then. It's very motivating!
Cute but would be nice to have more customisation of the character, a bigger room or more options in VC2.

I love this so much, it's really good, but I would like to suggest one simple thing if possible: daily, weekly and monthly report showing the amount of times I studied!
Honestly, the way it is right now is perfect, but this would make it even better! I recommended Virtual Cottage to a few friends and some of them were kinda upset for it not having a daily/weekly/monthly report feature so they continued using another one that isn't really that good only because it has this feature, but they loved almost everything in Virtual Cottage as well. Anyway, great app, I'm loving it. :D
Super helpful to focus my studying. The graphics are very calming and the timer is useful. I like most of the music but would prefer there to be no speech/ voice on tracks as I find it distracting.

I was initially just gonna go for the achievements in this game, until it updated. The To-Do list update and the fire, and snow, and wind you can turn on and off at the click of your mouse, and that you can adjust the volume on each of them? It's amazing. I now use this as a timer and To-Do list and as a source of music for when studying (What it was intended for). I really enjoy it now. If they could add another part to this game, like a way to go outside and sit on a porch and watch the snow, rain, or wind that you set inside? Or having the option to lay in the bunk bed with a laptop and earbuds. I know that this is meant for studying and all but I still think it would be easier to do with all that if they can add that sometime in the future? at the time of this review I would give this game a good 7/10 because, it does what it's intended to do (Help with studying) and a source of music. My opinion could change I might update or give a new review but until then, 7/10.

This "game" not only helps me focus but also keeps me company during my lonely study time.

Thank you for making this game & Looking forward to your next update!

You get exactly what the description says. Relax in the cottage as you do your work. My only complaint for this is that the songs get quite repetitive after a few hours in. If more songs are added, that'd be great.

I also have some suggestions:
- Make a rewarding experience. For every few minutes or hours we spend, we get coins that we can use to customize the cottage, buy new stuff, change colours, expand the cottage, etc.
- Add more ambient sounds. Bird sounds, fireplace, winds, or heavier rain.
- Maybe having the option to redecorate, make our own cottage or the character, that would be cool.
- Add a feature where we can feed the pet, hehe.

I'm probably demanding too much for a free game, but I personally wouldn't mind to get a paid version if significant improvements and major features are added. Overall, this one is as good as you can get. The designs are pretty and aesthetic, the rain sounds are relaxing too.

Virtual cottage is a really effective way to get in focus and on task, with nice music and soothing rain sound effects to relax you while you work. personally I get in the zone almost as soon as open up the app. I love that you can write your goal and how long you want to work. putting that visually really helps me finish whatever it is I need to do. my only gripe is that I wish they would have more songs in their collection, as I keep getting repeats every few minutes. overall a great app, I'm surprised it's free!

Keeps me on task throughout the day and a huge help to remind myself when to take breaks. I love listening to rain and lofi playlists so this is absolutely perfect. I always need some type of tiny distraction when it comes to working and this a happy medium because I never get too sucked into it c:
An awesome game to study and focus on other things - so just keep this on in the background and you're doing fine!
It's a very chill game where i can listen to lofi and work at the same time. Very easy setup and cozy comfy vibes

Very chill and helpful as assignments pile up for me. The lofi music is pleasant, easygoing, and light! If you don't like the music, you can stop it altogether then just listen to the weather and the fireplace. Additionally there's a to-do list you can fill up and a timer to set focus on one thing at a time! It feels more engaging than just filling out the basic agenda and doing whatever else to get things done.

The visuals are simple and cute.! The colors are warm. You're left focusing on yourself in a small room for eternity.! I wish it had more music in the playlist. I might consider buying the DLC.
Wholesome game to help motivate you. Nice music to listen to while working on paper work.
I love those nature sounds and the relaxing soundtracks. Really hope we could have more nice music in the future<3
its cool to study to n its free, what more could u want? also the kitty does different things. i repeat the kitty does different things
It's a really great monitor to get work done, and you can alter the vibe to whatever you like. I have trouble focusing on tasks usually and this has helped a lot with focusing.

Used to use this quite often when I was still studying for my high-school exams. It's nice.
EDIT: It uses in-game time to track achievements, so if you are a dog like me and playing on a different computer, look forward to spending another 100 hours in the game!

I guess I can't really call this a game, but it's a great productivity tool. Perhaps a wider selection of music would be great, since I've used it so much and hear the same songs but still it's a nice tool to chill and help me focus. The addition of weather effects like rain, fireplace, snow and wind are cool too.

And it's free, so just download it and enjoy!
really good study buddy, the addition of the snow, wind, and fireplace sound effects make it a much more calming app to have open

Before this I use to watch Lofi playlists on youtube in one tab, asoftmurm.ur and a comfy rainy 8bit gif lol

This is great because it's all that in one!

Great for chilling and having some ambient sound while doing homework, listening to podcasts and my personal favourite drawing :)

Enjoy your chills Kings <3

I noticed this game in the store yesterday as I was browsing through and saw how cute it was. I downloaded it today after adding it to my library yesterday and played it while I worked on some work I needed to get done. It is so cute with being able to choose between a dog or a cat by your side and letting the user pick between different background sounds like rain, snow, or wind with a fireplace. The music was also very calming and helped me focus. :) 10/10 love it <3
This game is calming, and feels home-like? I recommend adding some features you can interact with like petting your dog or cat. And maybe adding a variety of them!
